definitions.explanation: A facility providing childcare for infants and young children, typically while parents work.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{保育園|ほいくえん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|かよ}って→通う：01217_kayou⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: My child goes to nursery school.

examples.japanese: {保育園|ほいくえん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}れなくて→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦{困|こま}って→困る：00861_komaru⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I'm having trouble because I can't get a place at nursery school.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧{保育園|ほいくえん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{送|おく}って→送る：00742_okuru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{出勤|しゅっきん}する→出勤：04548_shukkin⟧。
examples.english: I drop the child off at nursery school every morning before going to work.

examples.japanese: {保育園|ほいくえん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧7⟦{時|じ}→時：09869_ji⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{夕方|ゆうがた}→夕方：01010_yuugata⟧6⟦{時|じ}→時：09869_ji⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{開|あ}いて→開く：00689_aku⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The nursery school is open from 7 a.m. to 6 p.m.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧{保育園|ほいくえん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{申|もう}し{込|こ}み→申し込み：03161_moushikomi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}くて→多い：01127_ooi⟧、⟦なかなか→なかなか：01547_nakanaka⟧⟦{入|はい}れない→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: Popular nursery schools get so many applications that it's hard to get in.

notes:
{保育園|ほいくえん} is the everyday name for a licensed daycare center (⟦{保育|ほいく}→保育：11461_hoiku⟧ + {園|えん}); ⟦{保育所|ほいくしょ}→保育所：31461_hoikusho⟧ is the official, legal term for the same facility.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{幼稚園|ようちえん}→幼稚園：04703_youchien⟧: kindergarten; education-focused, ages 3 to 5, shorter hours. A {保育園|ほいくえん} takes children from infancy and stays open long hours for working parents.
- ⟦{保育所|ほいくしょ}→保育所：31461_hoikusho⟧: the official term for the same facility
- ⟦{託児所|たくじしょ}→託児所：26912_takujisho⟧: any childcare facility, including short-term and workplace ones

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {保育園|ほいくえん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{預|あず}ける→預ける：01819_azukeru⟧ (to leave a child at daycare)
- {保育園|ほいくえん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧ (to get a child into daycare)
- {保育園|ほいくえん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{送|おく}る→送る：00742_okuru⟧ / ⟦{迎|むか}えに{行|い}く→迎えに行く：25786_mukaeniiku⟧ (to drop off / to pick up)

CULTURAL NOTE:
A shortage of places has long been a social issue in Japanese cities; children waiting for a place are called ⟦{待機児童|たいきじどう}→待機児童：08624_taikijidou⟧.
